personalData.title: Thor has his Hammer, I have my Code
personalData.description:
2026-05-04 10:04:40.695 Hello!

I'm a software developer with a keen focus on PHP, WooCommerce, Shopify, and Laravel, ready to simplify your business processes. Independently, I've built over 100 WooCommerce stores for businesses across the US and Canada, some of which are now generating between $5M to $20M in annual revenue.

Over the years, I've gained valuable experience in the healthcare industry, understanding how to navigate the complex world of compliance to deliver effective solutions. This knowledge extends to other regulated industries, where I can confidently build compliant and efficient software solutions.

A significant part of my work involves building custom Laravel applications for small businesses, creating bespoke WooCommerce plugins, ensuring security, and overseeing dev-ops. Whether you need someone to handle your existing WooCommerce store or need a custom Laravel application for your business, I'm here to help.

Many of my satisfied clients suggested that more businesses on Upwork could benefit from my services, and so here I am! I'm also planning to invite even more of my international clients to this platform for seamless collaboration.

Working with me, you'll get:

Clear, jargon-free communication - I ensure that I understand your needs and keep you updated every step of the way.

Customized solutions - I build software that fits your business like a glove.

A problem-solving mindset - I love tackling challenges and finding the right solutions for you.

Thank you for considering my profile. I'm excited to help your business thrive through effective software solutions.

Best Wishes,
Balu
